description.value:
Mon Calamari are an amphibious, salmon-hued humanoid species from the ocean world of Mon Cala, celebrated across the galaxy for their brilliant engineering and shipbuilding — Mon Calamari cruisers and shipyards are renowned even among Core World naval architects. Their large, expressive eyes and domed heads are adaptations to a life spent both beneath the waves and beneath the stars.

Mon Calamari culture places tremendous value on craftsmanship, cooperation, and resilience in the face of adversity, virtues that saw their species through devastating civil war and, later, occupation.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: You can breathe both air and water, and you have a swimming speed of 30 feet.

traits.name: Master Engineer
traits.description: You are proficient with one type of artisan's tools of your choice, and you have advantage on Intelligence checks made to design, repair, or improve mechanical or technological devices.

traits.name: Resilient People
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened, a trait born of your species' long history of enduring hardship without losing hope.
